# HealthPlus by SEHA Medical — Midnapore Primary, Walk-In & Specialist Medical Centre (Calgary, AB)

> **HealthPlus by SEHA Medical** is a comprehensive, multidisciplinary medical clinic located at **100-290 Midpark Way SE, Midnapore, Calgary, AB T2X 1P1**. Operating as the South Calgary flagship hub of the SEHA Medical Network, HealthPlus brings together **11 Family Physicians**, a **6-Day Walk-In Medical Clinic**, and **5 In-House Specialist Consultants** (Obstetrics & Gynecology, Pediatrics, Internal Medicine & Infectious Diseases, Psychiatry, and Sport & Exercise Medicine) under one roof.

## Direct Contact, Hours & Online Booking

  - Friday: 9:00 AM – 4:30 PM
  - Saturday: 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM
  - Sunday & Statutory Holidays: Closed
- **South Calgary Communities Served**: Midnapore, Sundance, Chaparral, Shawnessy, Somerset, Bridlewood, Millrise, Evergreen, Legacy, Walden, McKenzie Lake, McKenzie Towne, Cranston, Mahogany, Seton, Canyon Meadows, Parkland, Lake Bonavista, and Okotoks.

## Complete Clinical Program Guide (HealthPlus by SEHA Medical)

### Family Medicine (Primary Care)
- **SEHA Network URL**: https://sehamedical.ca/services/family-medicine
- **HealthPlus Midnapore URL**: https://healthplusmed.ca/services/family-medicine
- **Summary**: Comprehensive, lifelong healthcare for every member of your family — from newborns to seniors — with continuity, preventive focus, and genuine physician relationships.
- **Conditions Treated**: Routine annual check-ups and physicals, Chronic disease management (diabetes, hypertension, thyroid), Preventive care and immunizations, Minor illnesses and respiratory infections, Referrals to specialists and diagnostic testing, Prescription management and renewals
- **What to Expect**: Your family physician takes the time to understand your complete medical history, lifestyle, and current health concerns. At HealthPlus, we believe in building long-term, trusting relationships with our patients. During your visit you can expect a thorough physical exam, a review of your medications, preventive screening recommendations based on your age and risk factors, and an open conversation about any health concerns — from chronic disease management to mental wellness. We also coordinate with specialists and other healthcare providers to ensure your care is seamless and well-documented.

### Walk-In Clinic (Immediate Care)
- **SEHA Network URL**: https://sehamedical.ca/services/walk-in-clinic
- **HealthPlus Midnapore URL**: https://healthplusmed.ca/services/walk-in-clinic
- **Summary**: Prompt, no-appointment medical care for non-emergency concerns — available to all patients during clinic hours with minimal wait times.
- **Conditions Treated**: Cold, flu, and respiratory infections, Minor cuts, lacerations, burns, or injuries, Rashes, skin irritations, and infections, Sprains, strains, and musculoskeletal pain, Ear infections, sore throats, and sinus pain, Urinary tract infections (UTIs), Travel medicine and vaccination advice
- **What to Expect**: When you arrive at the walk-in clinic, our front desk team will register you and triage your concern. Patients are seen based on medical priority. A licensed physician will conduct a focused assessment, provide a diagnosis, and recommend a treatment plan — which may include prescriptions, requisitions for blood work or imaging, or a referral to a specialist or emergency care if required. Most visits take under 30 minutes from assessment to checkout.

### Internal Medicine (Specialist Care)
- **SEHA Network URL**: https://sehamedical.ca/services/internal-medicine
- **HealthPlus Midnapore URL**: https://healthplusmed.ca/services/internal-medicine
- **Summary**: Advanced diagnostic expertise and specialist-level management for complex, multi-system adult health conditions — coordinated seamlessly with your primary care team.
- **Conditions Treated**: Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes and metabolic syndrome, Cardiovascular disease, hypertension, and heart failure, Respiratory conditions including COPD, asthma, and interstitial lung disease, Gastrointestinal and liver disorders, Kidney disease and electrolyte imbalances, Unexplained fatigue, weight changes, or complex symptom clusters
- **What to Expect**: An internist specializes in diagnosing and managing complex, multi-organ medical problems in adults. At your appointment, your physician will perform a comprehensive history review, conduct a focused physical examination, order and interpret diagnostic tests (blood work, imaging, ECG), and develop an evidence-based management plan. They work closely with your family physician and any other specialists involved in your care to ensure a coordinated, whole-patient approach. Follow-up visits track your response to treatment and make adjustments as needed.

### Mental Health (Wellness & Support)
- **SEHA Network URL**: https://sehamedical.ca/services/mental-health
- **HealthPlus Midnapore URL**: https://healthplusmed.ca/services/mental-health
- **Summary**: Compassionate, confidential primary mental healthcare — offering assessment, personalized support, and evidence-based treatment for your emotional and psychological well-being.
- **Conditions Treated**: Anxiety, panic attacks, and generalized stress, Depression, low mood, and persistent sadness, Burnout and work-related mental fatigue, Grief, trauma, and life transitions, Sleep disturbances linked to mental health, Attention and focus challenges (ADHD screening)
- **What to Expect**: Your physician will create a calm, non-judgmental space where you can speak openly about what you have been experiencing. A comprehensive mental health assessment covers your mood, sleep, energy, social functioning, and history. Based on this, your doctor will recommend a personalized care plan — which may include lifestyle modifications, referrals to licensed counsellors or psychologists, psychiatric specialist referrals, or medication where clinically appropriate. Follow-up appointments monitor progress and adjust the plan as needed.

### MVA Care (Injury & Recovery)
- **SEHA Network URL**: https://sehamedical.ca/services/mva-care
- **HealthPlus Midnapore URL**: https://healthplusmed.ca/services/mva-care
- **Summary**: Expert medical assessment, injury documentation, and structured recovery planning following a motor vehicle accident — supporting both your health and your insurance claim.
- **Conditions Treated**: Whiplash and cervical spine injuries, Soft tissue injuries and muscle strains, Post-collision headaches, dizziness, or concussion, Low back pain and joint injuries, Psychological impact of the accident (anxiety, PTSD), Ongoing pain and reduced range of motion
- **What to Expect**: Following a motor vehicle accident, a thorough medical evaluation is critical — even if you feel fine initially. Your physician will conduct a detailed physical examination focusing on your musculoskeletal and neurological systems, document all injuries accurately, order necessary imaging such as X-rays or MRI referrals, and initiate a structured treatment pathway. We also complete the physician sections of your Alberta insurance forms and WCB documentation, reducing administrative burden during your recovery.

### Obstetrics & Gynecology (Specialist Care)
- **SEHA Network URL**: https://sehamedical.ca/services/obstetrics-gynecology
- **HealthPlus Midnapore URL**: https://healthplusmed.ca/services/obstetrics-gynecology
- **Summary**: Dedicated, compassionate care for reproductive health at every stage of womanhood — from prenatal monitoring to gynecologic screening and menopause management.
- **Conditions Treated**: Prenatal and postpartum care and monitoring, Menstrual irregularities, heavy periods, and pelvic pain, Menopause and perimenopause management, Cervical cancer screening (Pap smears) and HPV testing, Family planning and contraception counseling, Sexually transmitted infection (STI) screening and treatment
- **What to Expect**: Your visit will take place in a private, respectful, and comfortable setting. Appointments may include a physical examination, pelvic assessment, review of your reproductive health history, and targeted screenings based on your age and risk profile. For prenatal care, we monitor fetal growth, maternal health indicators, and prepare you for each stage of pregnancy. We prioritize clear communication and informed decision-making throughout your care.

### Pediatric Care (Primary Care)
- **SEHA Network URL**: https://sehamedical.ca/services/pediatric-care
- **HealthPlus Midnapore URL**: https://healthplusmed.ca/services/pediatric-care
- **Summary**: Gentle, family-centred health management for infants, children, and adolescents — supporting healthy growth, development, and every childhood milestone.
- **Conditions Treated**: Well-child check-ups and immunizations (newborn to 17 years), Acute childhood illnesses — coughs, fevers, ear infections, and sore throats, Growth delays and developmental monitoring, Asthma, allergies, and eczema management, School performance and attention concerns (ADHD screening), Adolescent health including puberty and mental wellness
- **What to Expect**: Our team creates a calm, child-friendly environment where kids feel safe and parents feel heard. During well-child visits, your physician will measure growth and developmental progress, assess vision and hearing at key milestones, administer vaccines, and answer all of your parenting questions. For sick visits, we focus on a thorough, gentle assessment to accurately diagnose and treat the issue while keeping your child comfortable. We also take time to address any school or behavioural concerns parents may have.

### Sports Medicine (Injury & Recovery)
- **SEHA Network URL**: https://sehamedical.ca/services/sports-medicine
- **HealthPlus Midnapore URL**: https://healthplusmed.ca/services/sports-medicine
- **Summary**: Expert diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation planning for sports and activity-related injuries — helping athletes of all levels return to motion safely and confidently.
- **Conditions Treated**: Sprains, ligament tears, and joint instability, Muscle strains and tendon injuries (tendonitis, tendinopathy), Stress fractures and overuse injuries, Shoulder, knee, hip, and ankle injuries, Return-to-sport planning after injury or surgery, Exercise-induced conditions and performance concerns
- **What to Expect**: Your sports medicine physician will conduct a comprehensive physical assessment of the injured area — evaluating range of motion, strength, stability, and pain. Based on the clinical findings, they may order imaging such as X-rays or MRI referrals to confirm the diagnosis. A detailed recovery timeline is created with you, and you will receive guidance on activity modification, physiotherapy coordination, bracing or taping, and a safe return-to-sport protocol. Our goal is to get you back to doing what you love — as quickly and safely as possible.

### Virtual Care (Access & Convenience)
- **SEHA Network URL**: https://sehamedical.ca/services/virtual-care
- **HealthPlus Midnapore URL**: https://healthplusmed.ca/services/virtual-care
- **Summary**: Secure, convenient telehealth consultations with a licensed HealthPlus physician — accessible from anywhere via video or phone for appropriate non-emergency concerns.
- **Conditions Treated**: Prescription renewals for ongoing stable medications, Review and discussion of lab results or imaging reports, Minor illnesses and skin conditions assessable visually, Mental health check-ins and follow-up appointments, Specialist referral requests and care coordination, Travel health advice and medical documentation requests
- **What to Expect**: You will receive a secure link to your virtual appointment via email or SMS. At the scheduled time, you will connect with a licensed HealthPlus physician via video (or phone if preferred). The physician will review your concern, ask relevant clinical questions, and provide a diagnosis, prescription, or referral as appropriate. In some cases, they may determine that an in-person visit is necessary for a proper physical examination and will arrange this for you promptly.

### Women's Health (Wellness & Support)
- **SEHA Network URL**: https://sehamedical.ca/services/womens-health
- **HealthPlus Midnapore URL**: https://healthplusmed.ca/services/womens-health
- **Summary**: Comprehensive, personalized healthcare for women at every life stage — from preventive screenings and reproductive health to menopause management and bone health.
- **Conditions Treated**: Routine wellness exams and annual Pap tests, Contraception counseling and family planning, Perimenopause and menopause symptom management, Bone density assessment and osteoporosis prevention, Breast health and mammogram referrals, Cardiovascular risk assessment specific to women
- **What to Expect**: Your women's health appointment is conducted in a respectful, comfortable, and fully private environment. Your physician will review your complete reproductive and health history, conduct age-appropriate physical assessments and screenings, and engage in an open discussion about your specific health goals — whether that is optimizing your reproductive health, managing perimenopausal symptoms, or focusing on long-term disease prevention. We take a whole-person approach that considers both your physical and emotional well-being.

### Concussion Care (Injury & Recovery)
- **SEHA Network URL**: https://sehamedical.ca/services/concussion-care
- **HealthPlus Midnapore URL**: https://healthplusmed.ca/services/concussion-care
- **Summary**: Evidence-based concussion assessment, symptom monitoring, and step-by-step recovery planning — helping patients safely return to school, work, and sport through the Complete Concussions™ program.
- **Conditions Treated**: Recent concussions and mild traumatic brain injuries (mTBI), Post-concussion syndrome (headaches, dizziness, brain fog), Sports-related head impacts and collision injuries, Balance, vision, and vestibular disturbances post-concussion, Cognitive and memory difficulties after head injury, Medical clearance for return to play, school, or work
- **What to Expect**: Your physician will perform a comprehensive neurological examination assessing your cognitive function, balance, vision tracking, coordination, and symptom profile. Using the Complete Concussions™ evidence-based framework, they will identify which physiological subtypes of concussion are affecting you and develop a stepwise recovery plan tailored to your timeline. Follow-up appointments monitor your symptom progression, adjust your activity levels appropriately, and ensure you do not return to high-risk activities before you are medically cleared.
